title: Airy Croatian Kabanos Skewers
description: A light and flavorful Croatian dish featuring Polish kabanos, perfect for a quick snack or meal, this Whole30-friendly recipe is made with a mustardy twist and cooked to perfection on a raclette-grill.
instructions: Preheat the raclette-grill to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the mustard, coconut cream, egg, salt, and black pepper until well combined.
Add the chopped parsley and lemon juice to the bowl and stir until the mixture is smooth.
Thread a slice of kabanos onto each skewer, leaving a small space between each piece.
Dip each skewer into the mustard mixture, coating the kabanos evenly.
Place the skewers on the preheated raclette-grill and cook for 5 minutes, or until the kabanos is lightly browned.
Serve the skewers hot, garnished with additional parsley if desired.
Knead any leftover mustard mixture into a small ball and serve on the side as a dipping sauce.
